nodes.name: product impact
nodes.sector: Construction/materials and expanding product sectors; current records include textiles/apparel examples

relationships.evidence: The platform digitizes EPDs and links each record to its original verified source.
relationships.constraints: Programme licences, validity and PCR rules vary.
relationships.validation_question: Retain programme, declaration, PCR and validity identifiers.

relationships.evidence: The platform organizes EPDs together with their PCRs and uses rule linkage to support interpretation.
relationships.constraints: EPDs under different PCRs may not be comparable.
relationships.validation_question: Enforce PCR/version comparability checks before ranking products.

relationships.evidence: product impact team is publicly identified as owner for product impact.
relationships.constraints: The public actor label is preserved as published; entity typing is Not typed in this review.
relationships.validation_question: Recheck the actor identity and role against the public source in the next evidence review.
